cases.query: Create an AGENTS.md for our app so agents use the real commands, paths, and architecture rules.
Agents keep inventing test commands and hardcoding styles: revise our repo instructions to stop the guessing.
Our instructions list obsolete paths and duplicate formatting stacks: reconcile them into one authoritative home.
Draft a CLAUDE.md for this repo with verified checks and observable evidence for the work.
Capture where secrets, cached data, and token sources live so agents respect the boundaries.
Add a short UI section to our AGENTS.md: where the primitives live, the reuse order, our checks, and which rules lint catches.
Check whether the new settings page reuses our components/ui primitives or bypasses them with raw elements.
Update DESIGN.md with the token and component names agents may use and the rule for adding a new one.
Create semantic color and spacing tokens with theme pairs before we build components.
Write down the URL paths for our app and which areas are public, signed-in, or admin.
Design the dashboard shell with reading order and responsive behavior for wide tables.
